title: The Spire of Ironhollow Anew
author: Yara Brightwater
blurb: Jude Nakamura, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
